title: AI Weekly
sub: Le {n} notizie più rilevanti sull'intelligenza artificiale {window}
topic: AI News: covering models, applications, regulation, business, and general developments

areas.what: New AI model releases, research papers, benchmarks, technical breakthroughs, open-source models, architecture innovations
areas.not_for: Commercial product launches, policy discussions, funding rounds, general industry commentary
examples: GPT-5 achieves human-level reasoning on ARC benchmark
Meta releases Llama 3.1 405B: largest open model yet
新研究：Transformer架构在长上下文任务中突破性进展
Mistral Large 2 beats GPT-4 on coding benchmarks
areas.name: Modelli e Ricerca
areas.note: Nuovi modelli, paper, benchmark e scoperte tecniche

areas.what: AI product launches, feature updates, integrations, consumer applications, enterprise tools, copilots, agents, APIs
areas.not_for: Underlying model releases, research papers, regulatory decisions, funding announcements
examples: Google integrates Gemini into Workspace with new side panel
Microsoft Copilot gets voice mode and vision capabilities
Apple Intelligence launches with iOS 18.1 beta
ChatGPT Search now available to all users
areas.name: Applicazioni e Prodotti
areas.note: Lanci di prodotto, aggiornamenti, integrazioni e tool per utenti

areas.what: AI regulation, legislation, policy, compliance, safety standards, government actions, international agreements, copyright lawsuits
areas.not_for: Technical research, product launches, business deals, market analysis
examples: EU AI Act enters into force with phased compliance timeline
California SB 1047 passes legislature, heads to governor
UK signs international AI safety treaty at Bletchley Park
Copyright lawsuit against AI companies advances in US court
areas.name: Regolamentazione e Policy
areas.note: Leggi, regolamenti, standard di sicurezza e azioni governative

areas.what: Funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, valuations, partnerships, market trends, earnings, chip supply, data center investments
areas.not_for: Technical model details, product features, regulatory texts, pure research
examples: OpenAI raises $6.5B at $150B valuation led by Thrive
Nvidia acquires AI infrastructure startup for $2.1B
Amazon invests $4B additional in Anthropic partnership
AI chip demand drives TSMC record quarterly revenue
areas.name: Business e Investimenti
areas.note: Finanziamenti, acquisizioni, partnership e trend di mercato

areas.what: Any AI-related news not fitting other categories: opinion pieces, interviews, surveys, education, talent, conferences, benchmarks not tied to releases, miscellaneous
examples: Survey: 72% of developers now use AI coding tools daily
Geoffrey Hinton warns of AI risks in Nobel lecture
NeurIPS 2024 accepts record number of papers
Università lancia nuovo master in AI generativa
areas.name: Altre Notizie AI
areas.note: Opinioni, interviste, sondaggi, eventi, formazione e contenuti vari
